header.description: Two ways to grow your team: Payrolling (we employ, you lease) or RPO (we recruit, you hire directly). Built exclusively for Dutch companies using EU-based talent across IT, digital, admin, finance, and travel. You choose the model, we handle the hiring.

vacanciesSearch.heading: Find the job that suits you
vacanciesSearch.subtext: We offer multiple vacancies in our portfolio. Search our online vacancies.

whoWeHelp.heading: Who we help
whoWeHelp.subheading: Most staffing companies make you figure out which model you need. We'll tell you straight — four services, two ways of working.
whoWeHelp.groupATitle: Group A — We recruit. You hire.
whoWeHelp.groupBTitle: Group B — We employ. You lease.

cardsA.title: Recruitment / Placement
cardsA.desc: You already know roughly who you want — you just need someone to find and vet them. We run the search, the shortlist, and the interviews. The candidate goes straight onto your payroll.
cardsA.fit: It's a one-off hire and you want the candidate on your team from day one.

cardsA.title: RPO
cardsA.desc: You're hiring for more than one role, or you will be over the next few months. We run your recruitment process end-to-end — embedded in your hiring calendar, not a single search.
cardsA.fit: You're building out a team, not filling one seat.

cardsB.title: Temporary Staffing / Staff Outsourcing
cardsB.desc: You need someone working for you without adding headcount to your own payroll. We employ them — contracts, payroll, tax, Dutch labor law — and you direct the day-to-day work.
cardsB.fit: The need is short-to-medium term, or you're not ready to commit to a direct hire yet.

cardsB.title: Payrolling
cardsB.desc: You've already found your candidate yourself. We become the legal employer on paper — contracts, payroll, tax — while they work exclusively for you.
cardsB.fit: You've sourced the person already and just need the employment relationship handled.

whoWeHelp.bannerTitle: Still trying to figure out the right fit?
whoWeHelp.bannerDesc: Not sure which one? We'll tell you which of the four fits your situation — not just sell you the one we'd rather do.

whyDutchCompanies.heading: Why Dutch companies choose us
whyDutchCompanies.para1: Most staffing options built for the Dutch market fall into one of two camps. Offshore agencies place talent in India, Malaysia, the Philippines, or Colombia — cheap, but you're managing time zone gaps and a candidate who doesn't know Dutch employment norms. Or you get compliance advisors built to help foreign companies set up payroll when entering the Netherlands — useful if you're a US company opening a Dutch office, useless if you're a Dutch company trying to hire.
whyDutchCompanies.para2: We're neither. We're built for Dutch companies, hiring Dutch and EU-based talent, in your time zone, under Dutch labor law, with both employment models — Payrolling and RPO — under one roof.

points.title: Dutch and EU-based talent
points.desc: Same time zone, same working culture, no handoff friction.

points.title: Both models, one provider
points.desc: You don't need a second vendor when your needs shift from temporary to permanent.

points.title: Built for Dutch buyers
points.desc: Not a compliance add-on bolted onto a service designed for someone else.

faqs.q: Is this legal under Dutch labor law?
faqs.a: Yes. With Payrolling, we're the legal employer of record — contracts, tax withholding, and statutory obligations are ours to handle, not yours. With RPO, the candidate is hired directly by you, under your own employment terms, so standard Dutch employment law applies as it would for any hire you make.

It depends on the role and the model. Payrolling pricing is based on the employee's gross salary plus a service fee; RPO pricing is typically a placement fee based on the role's salary band. We'll give you an exact number on a call once we know the role — we don't publish a flat rate because a Virtual Assistant and an AI Engineer aren't priced the same way.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Recruitment/Placement and Staff Outsourcing?
faqs.a: With Placement, the person becomes your employee directly. With Staff Outsourcing, we employ them and lease them to you — you still direct their work, but the employment contract stays with us.
